name: Saeki Hozumi
source:
A patient at Jomiya General Hospital.

She seems to have been in the hospital for a long time and has a sensibility that is a little different from others.

She is a quiet girl with a somewhat reserved personality.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1134]Getchu[/url]]
